key_insight: diff-soup enables GPU-native, differentiable simulation and inference for large, stiff PDE systems, reporting 10–100× speedups in forward solves and gradients on benchmarks.
engineering_relevance: It can accelerate physics-based parameter inference and learned constitutive models, including spatial catalyst-activity estimation in three-dimensional reactors.
method: Uses JAX for end-to-end differentiation of sparse PDE simulations.
Integrates NVIDIA cuDSS sparse direct solves with model and data multi-GPU parallelism.
Supports PDE-constrained Bayesian inference and embedded neural-field training.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports comparisons against established CPU and GPU frameworks on stiff PDE benchmarks, plus constitutive-relation inference and a 3D packed-bed reactor neural-field demonstration.
watch_item: Performance depends on sparse-system structure and GPU resources; the abstract does not specify benchmark sizes or hardware configurations.
paper_title: diff-soup: GPU-native Differentiable Simulation and Inference for Large-scale Stiff Dynamical Systems
